gloss_en: No'am — 'Pleasantness' (נֹעַם), the divine sweetness/delightfulness of Zechariah 11:7 ('One I called No'am'), identified in Likutey Moharan II:71 with the mentalities (mochin) of the Land of Israel and with the Supernal Pleasantness (No'am HaElyon) whose flow arouses the flames of love; not the proper name Naomi (נָעֳמִי) nor any verbal form of נ־ע־ם
